item.title: NASA Names Troy Asher Armstrong Flight Research Center Director
item.description: NASA Administrator has named Troy Asher as director of the agency’s Armstrong Flight Research Center in Edwards, California, effective immediately. Asher has served in several leadership roles at the center.

item.title: Contractor to Civil Servant: NASA Welcomes Jared Spiers
item.description: After years supporting the center as a contractor, Jared Spiers has joined the NASA workforce as a civil servant engineer at Stennis Space Center in Mississippi.

item.title: National Space Club Scholars Meeting
item.description: Students selected as National Space Club scholars met with mentors and staff during a meeting at the center this week to discuss internships and careers.

item.title: NASA’s Europa Clipper Launches on Journey to Jupiter’s Icy Moon
item.description: NASA’s Europa Clipper spacecraft lifted off aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Kennedy Space Center, beginning a journey of more than five years to study whether Jupiter’s moon Europa could support life. […]

item.title: Send Your Name to Titan Aboard NASA’s Dragonfly Mission
item.description: Lea esta nota de prensa en español aquí. NASA invites the public to send their names aboard the agency’s Dragonfly rotorcraft, which will explore the organic sands of Saturn’s moon Titan. […]
item.content:encoded:
Lea esta nota de prensa en español aquí.

NASA invites the public to send their names aboard the agency’s Dragonfly rotorcraft, which will explore the organic sands of Saturn’s moon Titan after launching in 2028. Names will be etched onto a microchip carried by the spacecraft.
